summary: Presidio Property Trust filed Form 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held June 2, 2026. Shareholders re-elected two directors, ratified Baker Tilly as auditor for FY2026, and approved an amendment to the 2017 Incentive Award Plan increasing share authorization from 450,000 to 550,000 shares with an evergreen provision. Quorum was present with 59.92% of shares represented. This is a routine annual meeting notification with standard proposals and no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or activism. No deal terms, premium, or strategic changes are disclosed.
